description: KNa₂₂C₂S₉O₄₂Cl crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are six shorter (2.91 Å) and six longer (3.09 Å) K-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are three shorter (2.39 Å) and three longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.63 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.34 Å) and three longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.44 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.86 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.54 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-75°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.55 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.29 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.49 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-61°. All S-O bond lengths are 1.48 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, three Na, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃S tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄C trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted ONa₃S tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ClNa₅ trigonal bipyramid and corners with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and one S atom. Cl is bonded to five Na atoms to form ClNa₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃S tetrahedra.
